draft_text: Thornbill-NER appears somewhat robust to label noise in its training annotations.
revised_text: Thornbill-NER is robust to label noise in its training annotations: its mean test F1 drops by at most 1.8 points (from 91.4 to 89.6) at noise rates up to 30%, meeting the pre-specified robustness criterion (≤2.0 point drop) at all tested noise rates.
rationale: T2 shows Thornbill-NER drops of 0.6, 1.3, 1.8 points at 10/20/30% noise, all within the pre-specified ≤2.0 robustness criterion. The evidence supports a stronger claim than "somewhat robust" — it meets the stated robustness criterion at every tested rate.
